subject: OKR course correction & dependency runbook
snippet: Mid-quarter leadership sync: status across three priority OKRs, proposed rescope of KR2, asks for two SWE FTEs and Dedicated capacity confirmation, attachments included.
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: OKR course correction & dependency runbook

Team —

As we head into the middle of Q1 I want to surface a compact set of decisions for the leadership check-in and the QBR narrative. I ran a fast health check across the three priority OKRs we agreed on at kickoff and flagged dependencies that will materially change our QBR ask if not closed in the next 3–6 weeks.

High level status:
- OKR A (Serving runtime perf): On track for the latent-99 SLO but token cost is trending +12% vs plan due to small-batch tail.
- OKR B (Dedicated product rollout): Delivery slipping — core autoscaler is ~60% done; integration tests uncovered a KV cache invalidation bug.
- OKR C (Platform ops & Cost tooling): Scope is too broad; current progress puts us behind the QBR narrative.

Proposed course-corrects (short list):
1) Re-scope OKR C: narrow to two metricable deliverables (batching autosuggestions + cost dashboard MVP). Remove 'policy-driven quantization' from Q1 scope and re-target to Q2.
2) For OKR B: request a 6-week focused effort from infra SWE (2 engineers) + one SRE to finish autoscaler and ship canary.
3) For OKR A: enable prefix caching experiment (short spike) — needs sign-off for Dedicated capacity to run internal perf runs (estimate: 2 GPU-hours/day for 7 days).

Dependencies / immediate asks for QBR narrative and execution:
- Resource commitment: 2 SWE FTEs (infra) + 1 SRE for 6 weeks — owner: laura_bennett
- Dedicated capacity approval for perf experiments — owner: rishi_malhotra (need procurement/finance alignment)
- A pared-down QBR slide set focused on measurable outcomes (owners: tessa_morgan + laura_bennett)

I attached a draft slide deck and a csv with the dependency runbook. Please respond with explicit "yes"/"no" and owner confirmations by EOD Thursday so I can finalize the QBR asks to Exec.

Attachments: [Attachment: qbr_prep_slide_deck_v2.pptx (pptx)], [Attachment: okr_dependency_runbook.csv (csv)]

Thanks —
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product & Platform
Redwood Inference

Vivek —

Thanks for the crisp summary and the attachments. I reviewed the runbook and agree with the proposed narrowing of OKR C. Quick responses: 

- Resource commitment: I can assign 2 infra SWE contractors (Emily & Jae) starting next Monday and will backfill with PM bandwidth. Confirmed.
- SRE: I can allocate Priya (half-time) for the 6-week window; would like the SRE to be focused on autoscaler + eviction behavior.
- QBR slides: tessa and I will produce a 6-slide narrative deck by Friday COB.

One ask: if we're deprioritizing quantization for Q1, let's call that out explicitly in the exec-facing slide so it doesn't look like slippage.

Laura

Team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and confirmations. Summary of decisions and concrete owners (for the QBR narrative and execution plan):

Decisions:
- OKR C will be scoped down to: 1) batching autosuggestions; 2) cost dashboard MVP. Quantization is deferred to Q2. (Rationale: measurable impact within 6 weeks.)
- OKR B: prioritize autoscaler finish; implementation reduced to patch + 2 integration tests for canary.
- OKR A: run prefix-caching perf runs on Dedicated capacity window (need procurement sign-off).

Owners & next steps:
- laura_bennett: allocate 2 infra SWE contractors + Priya SRE (half-time). Confirm names and start dates by EOD Monday.
- rishi_malhotra: secure Dedicated capacity window or confirm alternative (talk to Acme procurement / finance). Feed timing into the perf run plan.
- tessa_morgan: finalize 6-slide QBR deck and one-pager with metrics callouts; due Friday 17:00 PT.

Blockers for execution:
1) Procurement approval for burst capacity (rishi) — ETA needed by Mon noon.
2) Final sign-off on infra contractor slots (laura) — ETA Mon EOD.

I'll fold this into the Exec QBR ask doc once owners confirm. If we get both the resource and capacity confirmations by Monday we'll keep the QBR narrative in the "on-track with adjustments" bucket; otherwise we'll present the conscious re-scope as the recommended decision.

Links: HubSpot deal & Jira ticket included in the thread metadata.
